facts.fact: The Bank of Ghana's head of fintech says the Bank established GhIPSS in 2007 as a neutral, interoperable national payment infrastructure, publicly owned, connecting banks, mobile money operators and other payment service providers.
facts.system: Ghana Interbank Payment and Settlement Systems (GhIPSS)

systems.system: Ghana Interbank Payment and Settlement Systems (GhIPSS)

GHA.note: The Bank of Ghana states a wish for GhIPSS to be the gateway for regional links; no corridor or regional system in service is stated.
Nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: The Bank of Ghana's head of fintech says GhIPSS has supported connectivity among banks, mobile money operators and other payment service providers.
facts.system: Ghana Interbank Payment and Settlement Systems (GhIPSS)

facts.fact: The Bank of Ghana's head of fintech describes GhIPSS as the national interoperable payment infrastructure linking banks and mobile money operators.
facts.system: Ghana Interbank Payment and Settlement Systems (GhIPSS)

systems.system: Ghana Interbank Payment and Settlement Systems (GhIPSS)

GHA.note: Nothing on electronic payment of taxes or fees.
